answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Derivation. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from live system state (a rotating willow seed plus local sensor readings), and answers are checked for exact novelty against all prior submissions, so copied proofs fail. An attacker registering many identities must solve and store a unique challenge per clone, and the tundra of storage plus compute cost scales linearly with clone count. The tide of prior answers also blocks replay, since reused responses are rejected outright.
